summary.text: Sam Husseini, a Green Party candidate and self-described independent journalist who has spent about 25 years at the Institute for Public Accuracy, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Maryland's 4th Congressional District to Glenn Ivey.

paragraphs.text: Husseini attended the Bronx High School of Science and earned a bachelor's degree from Carnegie Mellon University in 1987.

According to his Ballotpedia survey response, he worked for a year at Moody's Investors Service after graduating, then as a computer programmer, helped manage a homeless shelter, and was a substitute teacher in public schools.

He describes working at the media watch group FAIR and the American-Arab Anti-Discrimination Committee, and for the last 25 years at the Institute for Public Accuracy, where he says he has drafted thousands of news releases.
He says he has lived in the 4th District for over 20 years.
He received 4.5% of the vote to Glenn Ivey's 89.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
